facts.business: Arisinfra Solutions Limited operates as a technology-led orchestration layer for India's infrastructure and real estate ecosystem, digitally integrating procurement, vendor coordination, logistics, and documentation across construction projects through its platform connecting developers, contractors, and suppliers.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Expected Credit Loss (ECL) allowance on trade receivables (Rs. 2,571.98 million receivables with Rs. 154.07 million ECL allowance as at March 31, 2026)

key_risks: Fragmented supply chain with 12,000+ quarry operators
Unpredictable execution and supply disruptions impacting project timelines
No standard pricing or quality benchmarks in aggregates ecosystem
Credit risk on trade receivables (ECL allowance of Rs. 154.07 million on Rs. 2,571.98 million receivables)
facts.related_party_note: Guarantees/surety/indemnity/comfort letters provided to support business operations and financial requirements of related party (BIPL); value up to limits approved by Audit Committee; solvency status of BIPL shown for FY2023-24 to FY2025-26 with turnover Rs. 1,769.60 million, PAT Rs. 50.43 million, net worth Rs. 43.30 million in FY2025-26
